text:
I will die in Paris in a downpour,

        on a day I already remember.

        I will die in Paris-and I do not run away-

        perhaps on a Thursday, as today is, in autumn.


        It will be Thursday, because today, Thursday, as I prose

        these verses, I have set my humeri

        badly, and never as today have I turned,

        with all my road, to see myself alone.


        César Vallejo has died; they beat him,

        all of them, though he did nothing to them;

        they struck him hard with a stick and hard


        also with a rope; witnesses are

        the Thursdays and the humerus bones,

        solitude, rain, roads...

translation.title: Black Stone on a White Stone
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the famous self-elegy's Thursday, rain, humeri, and third-person death.
